posts.summary:
The Department of the Treasury's Bureau of Engraving and Printing awarded a task order to Deloitte Consulting LLP under the GSA Alliant 2 contract vehicle on November 17, 2026. The task order, valued at approximately $12.3 million with a ceiling of $28.2 million, will run through May 20, 2027. The award was made through full and open competition.

Deloitte will provide information technology management support services focused on modernizing and transforming the Bureau's manufacturing execution systems for currency production. The engagement emphasizes technology-driven improvements to enhance automation and overall management of the production process.

posts.summary:
The Environmental Protection Agency awarded General Dynamics Information Technology, Inc. a blanket purchase agreement call valued at $6.3 million, with a ceiling of approximately $26.1 million. The award covers custom computer programming services in support of scientific modeling, application visualization, computational science, software, and statistical capabilities. The agreement was competed through full and open competition and runs from November 19, 2026 through November 18, 2027.

This procurement supports the EPA's work in ecotoxicology, geographic information systems, and related technical functions. General Dynamics Information Technology will provide professional support services across multiple specialized domains to enhance the agency's analytical and computational capabilities.
